scope: Synthetic test-fixture correction only; no production source change or real provider verification
finding: The old .7-second real deadline included child Python cold start, yet the assertion unconditionally required a PID file written by child code after grandchild creation. A missing PID file did not establish zero OS process creation or a containment failure.

additional_initial_failure.result: Second initial nine-case repetition failed with RuntimeTimeout at unchanged 5-second budget; exact stage unavailable. First repetition passed all nine.
additional_initial_failure.follow_up: Six instrumented runs observed natural exit 1, confirmed descendant cleanup and runtime_failed within 1.62-2.31 seconds; these do not establish the outlier cause. Existing failure case remains strict and is included in core/full checks.

historical_limit: The old failure did not retain Popen/resume stages; its exact process-creation state cannot be reconstructed. No historical PermissionError attribution is changed.

correction.timeout_cold_start: Retain real .7-second bounded_call. Observe Popen, suspended creation, resume, atomic readiness, completed cancellation and known PID exit. Missing readiness is permitted only after confirmed stop and runtime-thread completion, never treated as zero creation.
correction.launch_failure: Inject FileNotFoundError at Popen; require runtime_unavailable, no created/resumed process and no child marker.
correction.timeout_before_launch: Expire .7 logical deadline before Popen, then release the blocked launch on cancellation. Require zero Popen calls, finished runtime thread and no late child marker.
correction.timeout_before_resume: Create a real suspended Windows process, expire deadline before resume and require its recorded PID to be dead with no child-code readiness marker.
correction.timeout_after_launch: Observe atomic child/grandchild readiness before advancing the same .7 logical deadline. Require both PIDs dead after runtime_stopped, before outer containment teardown.
correction.observation_field_note: stopped means RuntimeTimeout.runtime_stopped. The launch_failure case independently asserts successful adapter.shutdown and no process creation.
correction.controlled_clock_scope: Only the fixture process talkabout.runtime clock reference is substituted for deterministic boundary cases. Process/adapter clocks, real cold-start timing and production code are unchanged.
correction.retained_limits: Original .7-second real cold-start budget, 5-second readiness/runtime guards, 15-second outer-parent limit, one-second CLI budget and 1.35-second assertion unchanged. No skips added or assertions removed.
correction.strengthened_checks: Atomic readiness avoids partial PID JSON. Known created PIDs are checked even without readiness; child and grandchild IDs must be distinct. Ordinary child failure must be runtime_failed, not any exception.
